example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘরের কুমির, সবাইকে ধোঁকা দিয়েছে।
ঘরের কুমিরকে চিনতে না পারলে বড় ক্ষতি হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a crocodile in the house, betraying everyone around him.
Failing to recognize the crocodile in the house can lead to great harm.
note: This idiom metaphorically warns against hidden dangers from trusted insiders, drawing on the image of a crocodile lurking in familiar surroundings.
